findings.issue: parse_payment_response returns success for a 200 whose TransferResponses entry has no PaymentReferenceNumber and a failed Status (e.g. Status 'Failed'); success is not conditioned on a reference or Status. Misreports a failed payment as paid (no extra money moves). Response shape unverified until G2.
findings.fix: Require a non-empty PaymentReferenceNumber (else unknown/failed 'no_reference') and/or inspect entry Status/ErrorMessage per entry before success.

findings.issue: 4xx other than 429 is a definite rejection; 408 (request timeout) can be ambiguous about receipt.
sanitize_provider_message redacts digit runs of 6+ only; hyphen/space grouped account numbers (1000-2000-3000) survive.
findings.fix: Also redact digit groups after stripping separators (e.g. r'\d(?:[\s-]?\d){5,}').
